title: Decision guide: choose between a lakehouse and a warehouse in Microsoft Fabric
content: Microsoft Fabric decision guide: Choose between Warehouse and Lakehouse Microsoft Fabric offers two enterprise-scale, open standard format workloads for data storage: Warehouse and Lakehouse . This article compares the two platforms and the decision points for each. The Lakehouse item in Fabric Data Engineering is a data architecture platform for storing, managing, and analyzing structured and unstructured data in a single location.
